source.title: A UNIFIED ANALYSIS OF LINEAR QUATERNION DYNAMIC EQUATIONS ON TIME SCALES

accepted.question_text: What theory and algorithms can resolve the selection problem for the constants alpha_1,...,alpha_m in Putzer's algorithm for homogeneous linear quaternion dynamic equations on time scales: given a constant quaternion matrix A in H^{n x n}, choose quaternion constants alpha_i so that P_0=I_n and P_k=A P_{k-1}-P_{k-1} alpha_k eventually satisfy P_m=0, making the Putzer fundamental-solution construction usable, including for matrices without enough right linearly independent eigenvectors?
accepted.context_brief: Putzer parameter selection for quaternion matrices

evidence.quote: Although there are some theoretical challenges on selections of α1, α2, · · ·, αm, the Putzer’s algorithm is still feasible.
